title: Noesis's filled OutSystems slot and 3,500-plus scale outweigh its eight-country reach
content:
Noesis brings multi-country reach — 3,500-plus people across eight countries from a Portuguese base — and the screen treats that reach as the weaker consideration. Two negatives outweigh it: the slot is filled, since the firm is an OutSystems Premier Global partner, and it is large.

Premier Global is the deepest tier of the relationship, extended across the firm's whole footprint rather than one country practice. That makes the app-layer occupancy structural: the certification investment, the co-selling motion and the pipeline all sit with the incumbent platform, so a competing typed-spec layer arrives as a threat to the practice.

The scale finding compounds it. Reach is only an asset once a firm has decided to carry something; before that, a 3,500-person organisation is a longer path to a decision than a small firm with the same platform position. Noesis therefore ranks below smaller OutSystems partners even inside the excluded cohort, where CLEVR and IG&H are named as the conversion targets worth keeping.
